newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says small fire extinguished at oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says small fire extinguished at oil refinery.

text.p: Mexico state oil corporation Pemex said on Tuesday that a small fire had been extinguished on Sunday at one of its oil refineries in the town of Salamanca.
The fire did not cause any decline in production, the state-owned oil company said.
"At approximately 02:55 on Sunday, October 13, there was a leak in the residue vacuum in the heat exchanger...which caused a fire," Pemex said in a statement.
"The fire was contained immediately and extinguished within ten minutes by refinery fire-fighters," the statement added.
Pemex made no estimate of the cost of the damage caused.
The refinery in Salamanca supplies the center-west region (of Mexico) with gasoline, diesel, oil and lubricants, a company spokesman said by telephone.
"Production was not affected," the spokesman added.
